title: Must, Must Not, and Because
label: ch:te-must-must-not-and-because
canDo: I can say what someone must, must not or had better do with -āli, -akūḍadu and -tē mañcidi, and explain why with -aḍaṁ valla, endukaṇṭē and kābaṭṭi.

payoff.summary: Complete TE-R319-advice-and-reasons: give advice and duties, put a reason before or after its result, and read the new letter ఓ.
